mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 4.5% for two consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand and profit pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when UNRATE > 4.5% for two months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) for two consecutive quarters signals deteriorating demand, which reduces corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of two consecutive quarterly declines in GDPC1 (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the Consumer Price Index above 3% for three consecutive months signals persistent inflation, prompting tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when CPIAUCSL > 3% for three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in payroll employment above 2% for two consecutive months signals robust labor market conditions, which boosts consumer spending and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods when PAYEMS > 2% for two months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1.2 million units for three consecutive months signals weakening residential investment, which reduces GDP growth and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when HOUST < 1.2 for three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the Industrial Production Index below 99 for three consecutive months signals weakening manufacturing activity, which reduces corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when INDPRO < 99 for three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 5.5% for three consecutive months signals a tightening monetary policy cycle, which increases discount rates and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when FEDFUNDS > 5.5% for three months (t-test p > 0.05).
